    enum 
    RcxRegulatedState
    The state of a regulated RCX pair, as the firmware reports it, plus two states the host itself determines: RcxRegulatedState.EXTERNAL_OVERRIDE when a manual output command took the outputs back, and RcxRegulatedState.LINK_UNKNOWN when the outcome of the last command could not be resolved over the infrared link.
